errors.evidence: In the example for the group "Жена, 19–25", the value for the fifth category ("Силно несъгласен", represented by a dark blue bar) is not 0%. The chart shows four bars for this group, corresponding to the first four categories in the legend. The value for the fifth category is missing and can be inferred as 0%, but the description presents this inference as fact without mentioning that the bar is absent. The description for the fourth bar, yellow (11%), is also missing from this example.

When giving the example for the "Жена, 19–25" group, the description omits the value for the yellow bar ("4 По-скоро несъгласен"), which is 11% according to the chart. It lists blue (37%), orange (16%), grey (16%), and then incorrectly jumps to dark blue (0%).
